Spacious Apartment Floor Plans in Westford

Open-Concept Studio, One-, Two-, and Three-Bedroom Layouts

Bell Westford offers thoughtfully designed apartment homes that combine sophisticated finishes with the flexibility you expect from upscale suburban living. Our luxury apartment floor plans have been crafted to support a range of lifestyles, from professionals working hybrid schedules to couples seeking additional space and residents looking for a quieter alternative to city living.

Our studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences feature open-concept layouts that create a natural flow between living, dining, and entertaining spaces. Expansive windows bring in natural light while enhancing the sense of openness throughout each home. Generous square footage, walk-in closets, built-in storage, and private outdoor spaces allow residents to create environments that feel organized, comfortable, and personalized, while select residences also feature private fenced yards and direct-access garages.

Designer kitchens anchor each apartment with elevated finishes and functional details. Quartz and granite countertops, oversized islands, custom cabinetry, and stainless-steel appliances provide refined style and everyday practicality. Interior finishes continue throughout with wood-style flooring, spa-inspired bathrooms, oversized soaking tubs, dual vanities, and walk-in showers available in select homes. Full-size washer and dryer sets add convenience while our roomy layouts can accommodate dedicated work-from-home areas, reading nooks, fitness corners, or guest space, depending on your needs.

Located near major commuter routes and the Tech Valley employment corridor, Bell Westford offers spacious apartment living that balances elevated design, functionality, and long-term comfort within one of the region’s most desirable suburban communities. Explore our floor plans below and find your new home at Bell Westford!
